message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Li (李某甲) is a tax official at county tax bureau, responsible for vehicle purchase tax. He used his position to obtain blank tax payment certificates, forged 38 vehicle tax payment certificates, allowing owners to avoid paying tax, causing tax loss 1,236,898 yuan. Some owners later paid back tax. Also, from 2011-2013, he used methods to change vehicle model, lower declared price, not collect full tax, for 28 vehicles, causing tax loss 235,412 yuan. Total tax evasion 359,051 yuan. He also forged 35 certificates (maybe 38? but they say 35). The prosecution says his behavior constitutes "变造国家机关证件罪" (Forgery of state documents). Also for the non-collection/under-collection of tax, they think it constitutes another crime, likely "逃税罪" (tax evasion) or "偷税罪" (tax evasion) or "徇私舞弊，少征税款" maybe "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain) or "国税局工作人员徇私舞弊罪". In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain, causing state losses). Also there is "逃税罪" for individuals evading tax, but here the official is causing tax loss by not collecting tax. The relevant crime is "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). Also "变造国家机关证件罪". So answer likely two crimes: 变造国家机关证件罪;徇私舞弊罪.

Check examples: In earlier examples, they used "受贿", "故意毁坏财物", "诈骗", etc. For tax evasion by officials, typical charge: "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). Also "国税局工作人员徇私舞弊罪". So answer: [罪名]变造国家机关证件罪;徇私舞弊罪<eoa>
